about: Optional per-body limb-loss rows. A body with no row here behaves exactly as before (global locational rows in data/rules.json). Read with loadLimbLoss(body); pass the row to createFighterState as opts.limbLoss. Every number below is a PLACEHOLDER until Strategy/Dom tune it.

rows.note: PLACEHOLDER (Sir Reginald, 2.18 m soft-skin boss). Sword-arm loss: he fights one-handed at 0.45 x damage (global row is 0.3). One leg gone: the game shows him kneeling (presentation of limp; both legs gone still kills). Budgets are scaled up from the part_hp rows for a boss; soft skin so no armour tier is implied.
rows.source: Strategy request 2026-10-28 (part-HP limb-loss rows); numbers are OWN start values, Dom/Strategy tune later

rows.note: PLACEHOLDER. A severed arm keeps attacking: physics only PUBLISHES this flag (on the fighter state and on the cut event); the game runs the swipe and the piece's hp. Budgets and multipliers stay on the global rows.
rows.source: Strategy request 2026-10-28 (cut piece keeps attacking); attack id and hp are OWN start values, Dom/Strategy tune later
